title: Environment
description: An execution environment for an agent.

environmentKey.description: Output only. Secret token generated upon environment creation for self_hosted environments. Used by the self-hosted sandbox daemon to authenticate polling and streaming requests. Only returned in the CreateEnvironment response; omitted from subsequent GetEnvironment and ListEnvironments calls.

sizeBytes.description: Output only. The total size of the environment files in bytes, output only.

mode.description: Output only. The compute lifecycle mode for this environment.

id.description: Required. Output only. The ID of the environment.

updated.description: Output only. The time at which the environment was last updated in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ).

created.description: Output only. The time at which the environment was created in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ).

fileCount.description: Output only. The number of files in the environment, output only.

status.description: Output only. The status of the environment container.

lastAccessed.description: Output only. The time at which the environment was last accessed in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ).

sources.description: Sources to be mounted into the environment.

customConfig.description: Output only. Arbitrary customer-defined JSON configuration passed through to the self-hosted environment poller. Only populated for `self_hosted` environments when configured.
